intro.eyebrow: Welcome to Smart Start The Premium School
intro.title: Not just a school. A [[second home]] for your child.
intro.text: At Smart Start The Premium School, every child's journey begins with love, laughter and limitless learning. We believe the first five years are not just about learning A-B-C, but about building a beautiful human being: confident, curious and compassionate.
points: Personal love, attention and care for every child
Learning through play, art, music and movement
A genuine partnership with every parent

images.alt: Teacher seated with a group of children in blue uniforms in a themed classroom
Toddler playing with stacking rings on a soft play mat

mi.title: Eight ways to be [[smart]]
mi.text: Every child is smart in a different way. Our Multiple Intelligence approach discovers each child's strengths and builds on them through play. Tap an intelligence to explore.

why.eyebrow: Why Smart Start The Premium School?
why.title: Four pillars that shape every day

items.title: Value-Based Learning
items.text: Sanskars along with smartness. We teach respect, sharing and gratitude.

items.title: Confidence First
items.text: Every child on stage, every child speaks. We remove fear and build leaders.

items.title: Safety & Love
items.text: CCTV, trained female staff and a hygienic campus. Your child is safe with us like at home.

items.title: Premium Experience
items.text: AC classrooms, international curriculum, activity-based learning and no rote learning.

philosophy.title: Marks can be improved later. Childhood confidence, once lost, never comes back.
philosophy.text: We are here to give your child a beautiful childhood they will cherish forever, not just formal schooling.

programmes.title: Our Preschool [[Programmes]]
programmes.text: Six age-matched programmes from 1.5 to 6 years that grow with your child, from first steps to school readiness.

environment.title: Spaces that invite children to [[climb, create & explore]]
environment.text: From the colourful play hall and ball pit to themed classrooms and creative corners, every space at Smart Start The Premium School is designed for curious little minds.
